configuration.inputs: Same eight observable event starts; one-hot event types for trees/MLP, learned type embeddings for GRU. Budgets and capacities differ.
configuration.models: Existing constant, linear, HistGradientBoosting, ContextMLP and shared multi-task GRU. No source pretraining.
configuration.selection: Existing fixed hyperparameters; target validation chooses neural checkpoints. Parameters were developed using England, before inspecting this extension.

limits: 范围是逐项2.5%–97.5%重采样百分位，不是同时置信带或已验证覆盖率的置信区间。
固定已训练模型、种子和抽样传球；不覆盖训练、选参、种子总体或场内再次抽样的不确定性。
重复球队的跨场相关和时间漂移未建模；不能据此推断未来赛季或因果效果。
以原英格兰实验的树基线为参照扩展到五个联赛；参数未按本扩展的测试结果调整。多项范围仅作探索比较。
test_comparisons.scope: 差值为各方法减去参照模型；正值表示误差更大。先逐传球平均固定种子的损失，再按整场测试比赛配对重采样，按抽到的传球数汇总；不是概率集成，也不是各场均值的等权平均。

limits: Single historical season, five target leagues; not cross-season transfer or an independent benchmark-design test.
England informed the existing architecture and hyperparameters; all league results retained without test-based retuning.
Fixed-seed mean losses and conditional whole-match percentile ranges; not ensembles, simultaneous coverage or training uncertainty.
No source pretraining; loader source sampling is retained to preserve the original target sample selection.
Repeated teams and cross-match dependence are not modelled. No football outcome predictor is replaced.

rendering.scope: Only the figure layout and run-ID subtitle changed after numerical execution; numerical execution source hashes and run ID retained.
